keywords: the ass and the old shepherd
full_text:
When raiders approached, the shepherd urged his ass to run. The ass asked: "Will the enemy load me with two packs?"

"No," said the shepherd.

"Then I shall stay," replied the ass, "for one pack is all I ever carry."
moral: To a drudge, a change of rulers brings no change of burdens.
